description: Smart money and whale activity for a token, straight from the chain: which large wallets are accumulating or distributing right now (buy/sell USD, net, average buy and sell price, realized profit, what they still hold), who the first buyers after launch were and whether they still hold or sold everything, and how much of the volume is bots. Trades are attributed to the wallet that really received or sent the token, so Coinbase smart wallets and aggregator routes count as the real trader. Wallet types from on-chain data: trader, fresh_wallet (< 10 tx, possible insider), smart_account, high_frequency_bot, contract. Base, Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Optimism. For trading agents deciding whether to follow or avoid a token. Price: $0.015 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"token":"0x532f27101965dd16442E59d40670FaF5eBB142E4","chain":"base","hours":3}.

chain.description: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, avalanche or optimism. Default base

early_buyers.description: Also list the first 20 buyers after launch and whether they still hold

hours.description: Window for current whale activity, 1 to 24 (limited to the most recent blocks the node serves, about 5.5 h on Base)

include_bots.description: Keep bots and contracts in large_wallets instead of listing them separately

min_usd.description: USD a wallet must have bought or sold to count as large. Default: 5% of the window volume, between 50 and 1000

name: token_smart_money
title: Token Smart Money and Whale Tracker
